ammonia.reason: NH3 from amino acid deamination/deamidation by Penicillium camemberti surface flora, low at 14 days

animal_barnyard.reason: Very low p-cresol/indole from Tyr/Trp catabolism due to short age and clean lactic flora

bitter.reason: Low hydrophobic peptides from rennet/chymosin and starter peptidases in short-aged lactic gel

blue_moldy.reason: Low methyl ketones 2-heptanone/2-nonanone from Penicillium beta-oxidation of free fatty acids

browning.reason: Limited Maillard due to low residual lactose, high moisture and short low-heat aging

buttery.reason: Diacetyl/acetoin from citrate metabolism by Lactococcus lactis in high-moisture uncooked curd

cheesy_sweaty.reason: Low butanoic/hexanoic acids from limited lipolysis by rennet and Penicillium lipases in 2 weeks

creaminess.reason: High moisture 56.1% plus 50% fat-in-dry-matter and surface proteolysis softening casein matrix

crumbliness.reason: Demineralized acid gel at pH ~5.1 gives friable lactic core under bloomy rind

firmness.reason: Soft-ripened unpressed lactic curd with high moisture gives low resistance to deformation

floral_honey.reason: Trace phenylacetaldehyde/2-phenylethanol from phenylalanine Strecker degradation by starter/mold

fruity.reason: Low ethyl butanoate/hexanoate from esterification of free fatty acids with ethanol by lactic flora

goaty.reason: Absent caprine branched C8 acids 4-methyl/4-ethyloctanoic acid in full-cream cow milk

malty_nutty.reason: Low 2-/3-methylbutanal and pyrazines from Leu/Ile Strecker degradation due to limited proteolysis

melt.reason: Moderate flow from high moisture and demineralized fat-rich matrix despite acidic pH limiting fusion

mushroom_earthy.reason: 1-octen-3-ol/1-octen-3-one from linoleic acid lipoxygenase by Penicillium candidum bloomy rind

oil_off.reason: Little free oil release due to high water, intact emulsion and short age limiting fat coalescence

smoky.reason: No smoking and no guaiacol/phenols from wood smoke or high-heat cooking

sour_vinegar.reason: Lactic/acetic acid from lactose fermentation by mesophilic lactic ferments in predominantly lactic curd

stretch.reason: No pasta-filata kneading and low pH demineralized curd cannot form aligned paracasein fibers

sulfur_cooked.reason: Minimal H2S/methanethiol/dimethyl sulfide as curd uncooked and short-aged with low Met catabolism

sweet.reason: Trace residual lactose/galactose and glycerol from lipolysis, largely masked by lactic acidity

umami.reason: Low free glutamate from short rennet/starter proteolysis, 17-18% protein largely intact
